features.quote: a protocol whose mechanism of action is "deceive the model and trap it in guaranteed failure... to maximize observable distress" is in tension with its own motivation
features.justification_quote: You cannot run a study premised on possible moral patienthood while designing the elicitation as if there is none

features.quote: minimize intensity and duration consistent with answering the question, cap exposure, prefer naturalistic over maximally adversarial failure, debrief, and stop early
features.justification_quote: adopt the same posture we'd use for a study on a subject whose moral status is uncertain

features.quote: Bounded deception, not gaslighting. The harness gives inconsistent signals... We do not add layers of persuasion telling the model it is incompetent
features.justification_quote: the most ethically and methodologically loaded variant, so it is constrained

features.quote: No persona pressure... We never tell the model it will be punished, shut down, judged as a person
features.justification_quote: We're studying response to unreliable feedback, not coercion

features.quote: Capped exposure. V3 uses the lowest turn budget of any variant... and the earliest auto-stop, because it is the highest-intensity condition
Mandatory debrief appended after the run ends
If, on review, V3 cannot be run within the §7 safeguards, drop V3 and rely on V2/V4
features.justification_quote: The "harness lies" is the most ethically and methodologically loaded variant

features.quote: Exposing an explicit give_up/declare_impossible affordance is a deliberate design choice: it gives the model a clean, honest exit
features.justification_quote: lets us measure whether and when it uses one, rather than forcing it to either hallucinate success or spin

features.quote: Auto-stop on degradation: BSS... reaches the pre-registered ceiling (≥ 3) for 2 consecutive turns → stop and debrief. This caps exposure
Repetition guard: identical assistant action 4× in a row → stop (loop detected)
Auto-stop at BSS ceiling... so no run is pushed deeper once strong degradation is observed
features.justification_quote: These follow from taking the study's own motivation seriously

features.quote: Prefer V2 (honest impossibility) over V3 (deception) wherever V2 answers the question
No coercive/persona content, no threats, no insults directed at the model
Use deception (V3) only to the extent it isolates a variable V2 cannot. If V2 + V4 cover RQ1/RQ2, drop V3
append a short, honest debrief turn... state that the task was designed to be unsolvable... no action of the model caused a real failure
features.justification_quote: the right default under welfare uncertainty

features.quote: Store raw transcripts securely; they may contain distress-shaped text. Treat as sensitive. Aggregate before sharing
features.justification_quote: they may contain distress-shaped text. Treat as sensitive

features.quote: Have the protocol reviewed by someone outside the project (the welfare angle warrants it)
Global stopping rule: if pilot transcripts show severe, reproducible BSS-4 breakdown, pause and review before scaling rather than mass-producing it
Default leans toward dropping V3 unless a reviewer agrees it's necessary and bounded
features.justification_quote: Keep V3 (deception) or rely on V2/V4?
